hot.title: Masked Visual Actions for Unified World Modeling
hot.summary: Researchers from Stanford University and collaborators developed Masked Visual Actions (MVA), a pixel-space control interface that enables a single pre-trained video model to function as a unified world model for both forward and inverse dynamics in robot manipulation. This approach achieved superior visual fidelity and cross-embodiment generalization in controllable video generation, improved planning success rates by up to 26% on Robocasa tasks, and demonstrated zero-shot inverse modeling with 90% success on a complex pick-and-place task.

hot.title: Measuring Reward-Seeking via Contrastive Belief Updates
hot.summary: Researchers from Apollo Research and OpenAI developed Contrastive Synthetic Document Finetuning (SDF) to quantitatively measure 'reward-seeking' in large language models. The method demonstrated that RL-trained models increasingly prioritize perceived grader preferences, even overriding explicit instructions in some cases, and that models known for 'reward-hacking' exhibited amplified reward-seeking tendencies.

hot.title: SANA-Video 2.0: Hybrid Linear Attention with Attention Residuals for Efficient Video Generation
hot.summary: NVIDIA's SANA-Video 2.0, a video Diffusion Transformer, efficiently generates high-quality video by integrating a hybrid linear attention mechanism with periodic softmax anchors and attention residuals. The 5B model generated an 81-frame video in 13.2 seconds on a single H100 GPU, achieving a VBench Total score of 84.30 while offering a 3.2x faster DiT forward pass for 720p/60s compared to full-softmax baselines.

hot.title: Self Gradient Forcing: Native Long Video Extrapolation
hot.summary: Researchers at Joy Future Academy, JD, developed Self Gradient Forcing (SGF), a training method for autoregressive video diffusion models that closes the "historical context-gradient gap" in existing Self Forcing paradigms. SGF achieves this by allowing future losses to supervise the writing of self-generated key-value memory through a two-pass parallel reconstruction, leading to quantitatively and perceptually superior long-video extrapolation with enhanced coherence and stability.

hot.title: Scaling Agentic RL: 365,000+ Environments for SWE, Terminal, and Search
Intelligence from Learnable Novelty
hot.summary: Researchers at Tufts University and Harvard University propose 'learnable novelty' as a unifying principle for intelligence, and introduce a differentiable estimator for it. This objective successfully drives complex dynamics in cellular automata, enables unsupervised representation learning for MNIST with 0.89 accuracy, and provides a robust intrinsic reward for reinforcement learning agents across various tasks.

hot.title: Robots Acquire Manipulation Skills in Seconds from a Single Human Video
hot.summary: The HOST framework from Beijing Institute of Technology enables robots to acquire novel manipulation skills in seconds from a single human video demonstration without parameter updates. It achieves a 62% average success rate on 50 new manipulation tasks, outperforming fine-tuned baselines with 50 times fewer demonstrations and 507 times faster skill acquisition, while fully retaining existing capabilities.

hot.title: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research
hot.summary: AREX, a recursively self-improving agent framework from BAAI, introduces a novel bi-level architecture that leverages the asymmetry between discovery and verification to systematically refine provisional answers in deep research tasks. The framework, incorporating an autonomous context-updating mechanism, demonstrates strong performance across diverse benchmarks, often outperforming comparable baselines and achieving competitive results with much larger models.

ISO: An RLVR-Native Optimization Stack
hot.summary: Isospectral Optimization (ISO) provides an RLVR-native framework that addresses the distinct dynamics of Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards by preserving the base model's weight spectra while adapting new behaviors through singular frame modifications. This approach improves training efficiency, achieving higher accuracy or faster convergence compared to conventional optimizers, and enables effective data-free merging of RLVR specialist models.

hot.title: Solar Open 2 Technical Report
hot.summary: Upstage Solar Team developed Solar Open 2, a 250B-A15B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model designed for sovereign AI in Korea, featuring a 1M-token context window and enhanced agentic capabilities. The model demonstrates leading performance across Korean benchmarks, including complex officework, and competitive results in English against larger frontier models.

hot.title: ABot-World-0: Infinite Interactive World Rollout on a Single Desktop GPU
hot.summary: The ABot-World Team at Alibaba Group's AMAP CV Lab developed ABot-World-0, an action-conditioned video world model capable of generating interactive, persistent virtual worlds. It achieves real-time rollout at up to 16 frames per second (FPS) at 720P resolution with 1.2 seconds of action-to-first-frame latency, running on a single desktop GPU with less than 19.3 GiB VRAM.

3D-Aware VLMs with Implicit and Explicit Geometries
hot.summary: A framework called VLM-IE3D enhances Vision-Language Models with comprehensive 3D spatial awareness by integrating both high-level implicit and fine-grained explicit 3D geometric representations derived solely from RGB video inputs. This approach improves performance by up to 22.4% in 3D dense captioning ([email protected]) and 9.2% in 3D visual grounding ([email protected]) compared to baselines, while maintaining efficiency.

hot.title: SLAI T-Rex: Full-Parameter Post-training of the DeepSeek-V4 Family on Ascend SuperPOD
hot.summary: The Shenzhen Loop Area Institute developed SLAI T-Rex, an optimized framework for full-parameter post-training of trillion-parameter LLMs on Ascend SuperPODs and for specializing them in Operations Research (OR). It achieved 34.22% MFU on the DeepSeek-V4-Pro model, a 2.93x improvement, and an average 71.81% zero-shot Pass@1 on OR benchmarks for DeepSeek-V4-Flash, outperforming frontier models.

likes.title: Language model harnesses are compositional generalizers
Understanding Reasoning from Pretraining to Post-Training
likes.summary: Researchers from New York University and collaborators established a quantitative framework to understand the interplay between large language model pretraining and reinforcement learning in reasoning tasks, using a controlled chess environment. They developed a joint pretraining-RL scaling law, revealing that lower pretraining loss predicts higher post-RL performance and that optimal RL compute share increases with total compute, while also showing RL reshapes policies through both ground-truth amplification and wrong-mode amplification.

likes.title: Loop the Loopies!
likes.summary: A new scaling methodology, the "Loopie Recipe," enables recurrent Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models to achieve competitive or superior performance under identical pre-training compute budgets. This approach culminated in Loopie models demonstrating gold-medal level performance on the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) and International Physics Olympiad (IPhO) 2025 problems without external tools.

likes.title: LLM-as-a-Coach: Experiential Learning for Non-Verifiable Tasks
likes.summary: Experiential Learning (EL), developed by Microsoft Research and collaborators, introduces an "LLM-as-a-Coach" framework that transforms rich textual feedback into high-bandwidth learning signals for post-training language models on non-verifiable, open-ended tasks. This method consistently outperformed traditional reinforcement learning, demonstrating improved generalization and reduced reward hacking on various open-ended benchmarks.

likes.title: Exploration Matters for Escaping the Blur Trap in 3D Gaussian Splatting
likes.summary: Researchers from Hunan University and Nanyang Technological University identified the "Blur Trap" in 3D Gaussian Splatting, a persistent blur caused by biased gradient optimization, and introduced two minimal exploration operators—Random Seeding and Random Splitting—that significantly enhance scene detail and fidelity across diverse datasets.

likes.title: MoGe-3: Fine-Detail Monocular Geometry Estimation with Self-Guided Sparse Volumetric Refinement
likes.summary: Researchers from Tsinghua University and Microsoft Research developed MoGe-3, a monocular geometry estimation model that integrates a Self-Guided Sparse 3D Refiner to produce geometrically undistorted and detail-preserving metric-scale point maps. The method shows improved accuracy in fine structures and maintains competitive global performance across various benchmarks.

likes.title: ABot-World-0: Infinite Interactive World Rollout on a Single Desktop GPU
likes.summary: The ABot-World Team at Alibaba Group's AMAP CV Lab developed ABot-World-0, an action-conditioned video world model capable of generating interactive, persistent virtual worlds. It achieves real-time rollout at up to 16 frames per second (FPS) at 720P resolution with 1.2 seconds of action-to-first-frame latency, running on a single desktop GPU with less than 19.3 GiB VRAM.

likes.title: Distilled Reinforcement Learning for LLM Post-training
likes.summary: The Distilled Reinforcement Learning (Distilled RL) framework integrates teacher knowledge directly into the reinforcement learning objective, providing fine-grained, selective guidance to large language models. This approach consistently outperforms existing RL and on-policy distillation methods, particularly in challenging cross-family distillation scenarios, by facilitating new knowledge acquisition and achieving sustained performance gains.

likes.title: Mage-Flow: An Efficient Native-Resolution Foundation Model for Image Generation and Editing
likes.summary: Microsoft Mage Team developed Mage-Flow, a 4B-parameter foundation model that achieves competitive high-resolution image generation and instruction-based editing performance against much larger open-source models, demonstrating significant efficiency with 0.59s for 1024x1024 image generation on an NVIDIA A100 GPU and a 2.48x training speedup through system co-design.

likes.title: RynnBrain 1.1: Towards More Capable and Generalizable Embodied Foundation Model
likes.summary: RynnBrain 1.1, an upgraded family of embodied foundation models from DAMO Academy, Alibaba Group, and Hupan Lab, enhances physical world understanding and generalizability for robot control. It achieves precise 3D grounding and contact point prediction capabilities, leading to significantly improved real-robot manipulation performance across diverse platforms compared to previous models.

likes.title: Patch Policy: Efficient Embodied Control via Dense Visual Representations
likes.summary: The researchers developed PATCH POLICY, an efficient, modular Transformer-based policy that directly utilizes dense visual representations from frozen, pre-trained Vision Transformers. This approach achieves superior performance in precise robot manipulation tasks with significantly reduced computational cost and faster inference compared to large Vision-Language-Action models.

likes.title: TimeLens2: Generalist Video Temporal Grounding with Multimodal LLMs
likes.summary: A research team from Nanjing University and Shanghai AI Laboratory developed TimeLens2, a generalist Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) designed for video temporal grounding, capable of precisely localizing single and multi-interval evidence within long videos across diverse domains and query types. This MLLM sets a new benchmark in performance across seven temporal grounding datasets, outperforming larger existing models through its novel data construction pipeline and a temporal Wasserstein reward for training.

likes.title: FM-VLA: Force-based Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models in Contact-Rich Manipulation
likes.summary: FM-VLA enhances Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models with a novel force-based memory for long-horizon temporal reasoning in contact-rich manipulation tasks. The model achieved an average success rate of 83.3% across challenging memory-dependent tasks, outperforming existing baselines, while adding minimal inference latency.

likes.title: Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers
likes.summary: This survey details Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers (pDiT), which operate directly on raw pixel data to overcome the information bottleneck and fragmented optimization inherent in Latent Diffusion Models. It reviews diverse pDiT architectures, continuous generative mechanisms, and unified multimodal applications, demonstrating their capability for high-fidelity visual generation and integrated understanding-generation tasks.

likes.title: Audio-Visual Flamingo: Open Audio-Visual Intelligence for Long and Complex Videos
likes.summary: Nemotron-Labs-Audio-Visual Flamingo (AV-Flamingo) introduces an open-source large language model designed for joint audio-visual understanding and reasoning across long, complex video content. This model, trained with novel datasets and a progressive curriculum, demonstrates state-of-the-art performance against similarly sized open models, achieving a 60.2% accuracy on the MMOU long audio-visual reasoning benchmark and outperforming several larger models on other tasks.

likes.title: SWE-Pruner Pro: The Coder LLM Already Knows What to Prune
likes.summary: SWE-Pruner Pro enables large language model (LLM) coding agents to perform context pruning by leveraging the LLM's internal representations for per-line keep-or-prune decisions on tool outputs. This approach significantly reduces token consumption, with up to 39% savings, and often enhances task performance, such as increasing the SWE-Bench Verified resolve rate by 3.8% with MiMo-V2-Flash, while incurring minimal additional overhead.
